label: D1 after an a1 choice that went rare to S2 and was unrewarded (late episode, moderate value)
explanation: Fires only at D1, never at GO or D2. 82% of activation mass comes right after a trial where the agent chose a1, the transition was rare (reached S2), and in 97% of mass the trial went unrewarded. It is the D1 of a rare-unrewarded a1 trial, which a model-based agent should answer with stay; the next choice is a1 in nearly all cases. It also needs S1 to be good (84% of mass), the episode to be late (only trials 60-99, mostly 70-89), and the model value to sit in [5.2, 7.1]. Activation grows over runs of consecutive unrewarded a1 trials (top windows ramp from 0.4 up to 1.0 of max over repeated a1->S2 rare r0 trials). It does not fire after a2 choices, after common transitions, after rewards (only 3% of mass), or before trial 60. The remaining 18% of mass is D1 at the first trial of the window, where prev_* is unknown. Precision is low (about 0.13): most D1s matching the predicate do not activate. The late-episode gating suggests the feature also depends on an episode-time or drift signal that no predicate captures. Uses only observed variables.
